Subject: RE: Fwd: Granite Systems — Coupa accept flow failing (possible alias rewrite)

Hi team — looked into this with eng. Short summary and steps: 

Root cause hypothesis:
- Coupa's accept flow verifies the invited "recipient_email" against the user identity lookup that normalizes to the account primary email (our tenant expects exact-match). Granite's inbound mail gateway rewrites addresses to a different routing alias before the user clicks the control — the accept flow compares the rewritten header value and fails the exact-match lookup.

Immediate remediation options (pick one):
1) Re-issue the invite to the canonical corporate address (we suggest e.lowe@granite.corp or direct personal work address) and ask the user to accept that mail.
2) We'll create a one-time manual activation URL (expires in 24h) for that user so they can complete setup without re-sending the invite.
3) If they can accept from an incognito browser or after clearing site cookies (to avoid a stale session), sometimes the proxy rewrite isn't applied to the redirect chain — worth a quick try while we confirm a permanent fix.

Engineering notes (for follow-up):
- We can relax the match to accept known alias mappings for the tenant, but that requires tenant configuration and an audit trail (security review).
- I'll open a short internal ticket to add optional alias-matching for Coupa invites; timeline depends on product prioritization.

Work-around I'll perform now: creating a 24h activation link and a support ticket so the customer has a direct path. Support ticket: #88972. Manual activation link: https://support.redwood.com/tickets/88972 (one-time link delivered via secure channel).

Eric — I'll send the manual link by separate secure message. If you'd prefer we re-issue the invite to a specific address, tell me which email and we'll do it immediately.

Regards,
